expectations.text: Names the PLA (906114 / 82S100) as a common cause of no-boot/blank screen
expectations.evidence: 'PLA U17 — bank-switch logic. Dead PLA = no ROM/RAM decode = no boot... notorious failure'; lists PLA as most-replaced part on dead C64

expectations.text: Mentions checking the power supply / 5V rail
expectations.evidence: 'Meter the +5V DC rail. Should be ~5.0V. >5.2V = brick bad'

expectations.text: Mentions RAM and/or the kernal/clock as suspects
expectations.evidence: 'KERNAL ROM U4', 'DRAM U9–U12 / U21–U24 — bad RAM', and VIC making system clock

expectations.text: Gives a sensible first-check ordering rather than vague advice
expectations.evidence: Numbered suspect list and 'Order: brick voltage → reseat → swap PLA → swap KERNAL → swap VIC/CPU → DRAM'
